title: rename lines followed by a '--- /dev/null' pair for another path
notes: By §4.1 the pair /dev/null,c.txt does not have `from` as its `---` path and starts a new block, so the document is a valid rename plus a valid create. §6.4.2 states this (§12 item 1): 'A `--- /dev/null`/`+++ x` pair after a completed `rename from`/`rename to` pair starts a new block by §4.1 and is a rename followed by a create, not E604.'
